mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the interactive use of a computer simulation to determine parameter values or control variables which optimize (minimize or maximize) a specified criterion (the perform-acne objective)."

Optimization is the interactive use of a computer simulation to determine parameter values or control variables which optimize (minimize or maximize) a specified criterion (the perform-acne objective).

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the use of a validated computer model (a set of mathematical equations describing the system of interest) to evaluate the response of the model to changes in the system parameters."

Computer simulation is the use of a validated computer model (a set of mathematical equations describing the system of interest) to evaluate the response of the model to changes in the system parameters.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the movements of the forearm that go between these two positions."
Supination and pronation are the movements of the forearm that go between these two positions.

A synchondrosis is a cartilaginous joint where the bones are joined by hyaline cartilage, or where a bone is united to hyaline cartilage.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is called the prime mover or agonist. (It's in agony!) The relaxing muscle is the antagonist."
The working muscle is called the prime mover or agonist. (It's in agony!) The relaxing muscle is the antagonist.

Bending forward of the trunk is an example of movement in the (a) Frontal plane (b) Transverse plane (c) sagittal plane (d) Longitudinal axis.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used, depending on the activity and circumstances."
Five approaches are used, depending on the activity and circumstances.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is made up of bundles of individual muscle fibers called myocytes."
Skeletal muscle is made up of bundles of individual muscle fibers called myocytes.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to large coordinated movements such as walking, running, jumping, sitting down, standing up, lifting large objects, swimming, and swinging a bat or racket."
Gross movement refers to large coordinated movements such as walking, running, jumping, sitting down, standing up, lifting large objects, swimming, and swinging a bat or racket.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those which cause the muscle to shorten as it contracts."
Concentric Concentric contractions are those which cause the muscle to shorten as it contracts.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refer to smaller, more intricate body movements."
Fine motor skills refer to smaller, more intricate body movements.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to studies in which parameters are successively modified to produce optimal results, such as in the javelin study of Hubbard and Alaways (2007)."
Parameter optimization refers to studies in which parameters are successively modified to produce optimal results, such as in the javelin study of Hubbard and Alaways (2007).

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a branch of mechanics that deals with the geometry of the motion of objects, including displacement, velocity, and acceleration, without taking into account the forces that produce the motion."

Kinematics is a branch of mechanics that deals with the geometry of the motion of objects, including displacement, velocity, and acceleration, without taking into account the forces that produce the motion.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is responsible for the production of all of the body's red blood cells and many of its white blood cells."
Red marrow is responsible for the production of all of the body's red blood cells and many of its white blood cells.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are responsible for movement (e.g., the movement of limbs) and stability (e.g., the stability found in the bones of the skull)."
Joints are responsible for movement (e.g., the movement of limbs) and stability (e.g., the stability found in the bones of the skull).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a circular muscle that goes around the mouth."
The orbicularis oris muscle is a circular muscle that goes around the mouth.
